./jcr:created is the asset creation date/time and is a PROTECTED property
property_mapping.protected_property_guidance: For protected properties Adobe recommends marking them as Disable Edit
property_mapping.evidence: Map to Property: This property specifies the relative path of the folder node in the CRX repository where it is saved. It starts with './' ... ./jcr:created ... is a protected property. If you configure these properties, Adobe recommends that you mark them as Disable Edit.
